name: Oyako Saimin
original_name: 母娘催眠～オヤコサイミン～
source:
After becoming able to use hypnosis, the protagonist may try it on many groups of girls (involving a mother and her daughter)
But some are more dangerous than others.
Will it be a good ending?
translation:
主角获得催眠能力后，或许会尝试将其施用于多组女性，其中包括一对母女。
但有些对象远比其他人危险。
这会迎来好结局吗？
